# SourceFoundry v0.1.0

SourceFoundry gives coding agents a recurring, inspectable source feed instead of making every product rebuild polling, retries, deduplication, provenance, and source-health monitoring.

## Use it

- Hosted service and agent guide: https://sourcefoundry.4agents.fyi/agent.md
- Self-hosting: `docs/self-hosting.md`
- MCP adapter: download the attached `sourcefoundry-mcp-0.1.0.tgz`
- Container: `ghcr.io/ankaiinc/sourcefoundry:v0.1.0`

## Public-beta boundaries

- SourceFoundry supplies source candidates; consuming agents own ranking, writing, judgment, and publication.
- RSS/Atom works without a search provider. Tavily, Exa, and Serper require operator-owned keys and remain subject to their own terms.
- Pin exact release tags for production and keep API and worker on the same version.
